text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ghk... My right eye...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet suddenly mutters in anguish. 
For a moment, panic almost sets in, until 
I notice the faint smile playing at the 
corners of his mouth—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it seems it's aching... just a 
little. No, there is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness, it was just business as 
usual. While feeling relieved, I suddenly 
wondered. Come to think of it, her 
eyepatch..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What is it, does it trouble thee? 
That which lurks within the deepest 
dark—the abyss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing my gaze, Tanino Gimlet touches 
his eyepatch. Thinking it might be a 
delicate subject, I hadn't brought it up 
much, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Curiosity is a trap that kills all. 
Yet—if it's you, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Very well, try and expose me. Before 
the hound of hell bares its fangs, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a provocative smile, Tanino Gimlet 
lightly flicked the cord of his eyepatch. 
It was as if signaling the start of the 
game.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, Tanino Gimlet would often 
taunt me, gesturing as if she were 
reaching for her eyepatch.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, whenever I turned my gaze toward 
her, she would merely flash a captivating 
yet beautiful smile and walk away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: âUnder the eyepatch?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained the situation to Symboli Kris 
S, who was watching my exchange with 
Tanino Gimlet with a puzzled look.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...Top secret... —Surprising."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see— So it is permitted. —To uncover the 
truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S muttered that, and the 
corners of her mouth curved up slightly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I pray—that Lady Luck smiles upon us—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since then... Yet it 
seems the shackles known as reason still 
cannot hold you back, can they?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I may have provoked her, but she shows no 
sign of giving up. Why does she desire to 
gaze into the abyss so intensely?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though no specific action has been taken, 
my interest in the 'abyss' certainly 
hasn't waned. I answer Tanino Gimlet's 
question.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...With interest?
choice_data_list:
Because I get to discover a new side of 
you.

Because I get to discover a new side of 
you

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...... Facing mirrors, huh? Though 
reflected, one's true intent layers over 
itself, clouding the vision.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Trainer? Shall I show you? 
If you cling, lament, and desire it... 
right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this a provocation as well? I shake my 
head at Tanino Gimlet's proposal.
choice_data_list: You were the one who told me to expose it.
You were the one who told me to expose it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Are you sure about this? This might 
be your last chan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An overcast sky threatening a storm. A 
sudden gust of strong wind tore at Tanino 
Gimlet's eyepatch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up snatching it. The eyepatch 
swaying on the tip of the branch. The 
moment I saw that—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflexively, I grabbed the eyepatch. Then, 
moving behind Tanino Gimlet, I put it back 
on for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet looks dumbfounded. Seeing a 
rare expression like that, I instinctively 
blurt out an excuse.
choice_data_list:
No, it's just... I felt like it'd be a 
waste.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“...... I see. It was not a lack of 
courage to gaze into the abyss, but rather 
a ploy to tantalize what lurks within.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Or was I the one kept on edge...? Heh, 
I hate to admit defeat."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet muttered as if talking to 
himself. I was curious about what lay 
beneath his eyepatch, but getting to see 
such a rare expression was satisfying in 
its own right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I instinctively covered my eyes with both 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Did you lack the courage to gaze into 
the abyss?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to rely on mere 
coincidence... Does that sound strange? 
Still, that was my honest thought in that 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. The end is still nowhere in 
sight... The spiral corridor continues, 
does it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Being pursued by your gaze becomes 
addictive. Like savoring the transgression 
of reaching for the forbidden red apple.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words, too, felt somewhat 
provocative. As I averted my eyes, her 
usual fearless laughter echoed from beside 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I immediately looked toward Tanino Gimlet. 
And thenâ

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Haaah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet was already wearing a new 
eyepatch.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How foolish, Trainer! Even if the Goddess 
of Fortune smiles upon you, it won't be 
that simple!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, expose it! Tear it wide open!! Unseal 
the abyss with your very own hands!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked up at the sky, theatrically 
pretending to be frustrated. While it was 
indeed a little disappointing, part of me 
felt somewhat relieved that it wouldn't be 
seen.
